privateEvents.name: Mehndi
privateEvents.subtitle: An afternoon of henna, chai and music

venue.name: [Sharma Family Home]
venue.parking: [Street parking and driveway; please carpool where you can.]

privateEvents.description: Henna artists will decorate hands and arms while we share chai, snacks and music. Come relaxed and ready to sit for a while.

dressCode.title: Colourful and comfortable
dressCode.text: Bright, easy outfits you can sit in. Avoid long sleeves that cover the wrists, so the henna can be applied.
tips: Short or three-quarter sleeves work best.
Flat shoes or sandals; we will be on grass.

notes: Henna takes 3 to 4 hours to set; plan your evening accordingly.

privateEvents.name: Sangeet
privateEvents.subtitle: An evening of dance, performances and dinner

venue.name: [The Grand Ballroom at Lakeview Hotel]
venue.notes: [Dance floor and stage inside; cocktail reception on the terrace.]

privateEvents.description: Both families perform, then the dance floor opens. Dinner is served at 8:00 PM.

dressCode.title: Festive Indian or cocktail attire
dressCode.text: Jewel tones, sequins and sparkle. You will be dancing, so choose something you can move in.
tips: Lehengas, sarees, sherwanis, or a cocktail dress and suit are all welcome.
Comfortable shoes for the dance floor.
